chunks: So which of the favors of your Lord will you both deny?
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the refrain 'Fabi-ayyi ala'i rabbikuma tukadhdhiban' in Surah Ar-Rahman?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this refrain is interpreted as a dual address to humans and jinn, highlighting the overwhelming abundance of divine favors that render denial impossible. It underscores the theological concept of 'tawhid al-af'al' by linking the recognition of blessings directly to the acknowledgment of Allah's sovereignty.
